status: proposed research crosswalk; no mappings validated or adopted

sources.warning: README calls each sentence one role but describes ANALYSIS as parent co-tag on STA, PRE_RELIED and PRE_NOT_RELIED. Preserve possible multiple source labels; verify actual files rather than impose either interpretation. README labels include spelling typo PRE_RLEIED in prose; table PRE_RELIED.

Paper specifies exactly one whole-sentence legal label; its Argument is the court weighing parties, unlike BUILD’s party-specific labels. Source paper reports 50 documents; no count independently recomputed here.

Two orthogonal label layers: five actor types and sixteen legal argument types; flat token spans bounded by paragraphs. They are not source-target support/attack relations. Its raw UIMA gold and processed The Law onward BIO layers differ; avoid assuming complete document context.

echr_argument_layer.unit: token-aligned span, cannot cross source paragraph; actor layer independent

examples.condition: Only if the text compares relevant facts or develops an inference; legal label alone is not proof of either.
A cited precedent does not itself support a claim; verify linkage and comparison basis.
A legal decision can be an institutional action. Do not automatically assign assert.
Text must make inference, explain connection or supply a reason for an identifiable decision.

echr_argument_layer.coverage_note: Illustrative argument-type crosswalk only, not a complete enumeration of 16 legal types; full source definitions in section 3.1.2. Actors above are all five. No relation target is annotated in this scheme.

adoption_recommendations: Keep actor attribution independent of function and claim target.
Retain original legal labels and span coordinates; never coerce a single sentence role into a mandatory single paragraph function.
Pilot context windows and expert review; preserve unresolved and mixed functions.
Check valid offsets, IDs, allowed labels and explicit relation references deterministically; semantic validity and actual support require review.
Use boundary cases where a citation only reports, legal command is quoted, a court issues an operative ruling, and competing parties are attributed.
Do not estimate target-form function frequencies from these non-target judicial datasets.
